## Where the plan stands
Gold Coast (S020, QLD Regional Standard) plans sales of AUD 1,510,572 at 3.06% LFL. That is -1.26 pts below the company's 4.32%. Its margin is 37.79%, against 37.95% for the company. It sits 0.36 pts below its peer rate of 3.42%, and it has a recorded reason: **CLEARANCE_PUSH**. The company plan is AUD 90,323,872 against a board-approved AUD 90,317,702. Hardgoods' gap in the planning chain is AUD -3,783,503.

## The options
| Option | Stores | Sales change | Margin change | Company margin % | Company / scope LFL | Vs approved | Hardgoods gap | Guardrail |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A: +1 pt every month | 1 | AUD 0 | AUD 15,106 | 37.97% | 4.32% / 3.06% | AUD 6,170 | AUD -3,783,503 | CAUTION: overrides CLEARANCE_PUSH |
| B: +1 pt Oct-Dec only | 1 | AUD 0 | AUD 7,391 | 37.96% | 4.32% / 3.06% | AUD 6,170 | AUD -3,783,503 | CAUTION: overrides CLEARANCE_PUSH |
| C: +0.5 pt every month | 1 | AUD 0 | AUD 7,553 | 37.96% | 4.32% / 3.06% | AUD 6,170 | AUD -3,783,503 | CAUTION: overrides CLEARANCE_PUSH |



Another point of margin changes only margin dollars. Sales, LFL, the position against the approved plan and Hardgoods' gap stay where they are, so no amendment to the approved plan is needed. Every option does override Gold Coast's recorded clearance push, because a higher margin cuts against clearing stock.

## Recommendation
**Option B**: +1 pt in the Oct-Dec peak only, adding AUD 7,391 of margin. All three options carry the same caution, so the tool picks the smallest change. Option A doubles the margin gain to AUD 15,106 but pushes against the clearance push for all six months.

## What happens next
Before opening any option, check with the store and merchandising teams that the clearance push can take a higher margin. This proposal (SBX-26111722344891) is a draft.
